Usage: gacli admin properties create [options]

Create a new GA4 property

Options:
  --account <accountId>           GA4 account ID
  --display-name <name>           Display name for the property
  --time-zone <timeZone>          Reporting time zone (e.g., America/New_York)
  --currency-code <code>          Currency code (e.g., USD)
  --industry-category <category>  Industry category
  -h, --help                      display help for command
